text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp ends. Wonder Acute pushed through
a great deal of training, and on the final day...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, this is...
In that hand... she held something that had no business being there.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... No, it's not like that~.
It's for Tarumae-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I lent it to her.
She said she desperately wanted to see
footage of Falco-san's races.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's review the footage of the Teio Sho held at Oi this June.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that...
That was an overwhelming victory, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It was a truly terrifying runaway pace. Nobody could even touch her shadow.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh…… Whoaaaa……
Falco-san really is amazing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Her running is great, of course, but...
this is it. Look at this.
Wonder Acute showed me a video.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To all my fans! I won thanks to you guys!
Thank you for cheering for me today, too☆
(UOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's cheers, their applause, their feelings,
they all pushed me forward as I ran in the lead...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It was a solo journey!
But the whole time, I was never really alone!!"
(UOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: At the end of the year! Come watch the Tokyo Daishoten held here at Ohi too~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw the ultimate year-end party
with all the dirt-loving Umamusume and fans!☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "These cheers... There's already a gap in our running ability, and having such a massive cheering squad on top of that...?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel like I can ever catch up...
'Umedols' really are incredible, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: An umadol! ...I am one, after all.
Hokko Tarumae wasted no time firing back with a retort.
choice_data_list: Still, you have your own cheering squad too, right, Acute?
Still, you have your own cheering squad too, don't you, Acute?

text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are people wishing for victory.
The trainees at the boxing gym,
the elderly folks in rehab...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Still~, fans like that won't be able to come all the way to the venue, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Especially for the grandpas and grandmas, if I don't win first to cheer them up, it's pretty tough, y'know?

...Now that you mention it, that's true.
There are quite a few hurdles for Wonder Acute's cheer squad to make it to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Don't let them overwhelm you, Acute-san!
I'm right here in your cheering squad! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If you enter the Tokyo Daishoten,
I'll cheer you on with feng shui cheers♪"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, that's true.
If Rickey-chan and Tarumae-chan
cheer me on, that'd be so reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hey, Tarumae-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Uh... I'm... umm...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If your opponent is Falco-san... I might not be able to root for you.
She's the senior I respect the most, after all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! But really,
that's the one thing I just can't dooo.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
Trainer-san, what was it called again?
Was it... "supporter"?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've heard that kind of power is important for Umamusume too, but if that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Going up against Falco's overwhelming surge might be quite a chore.
Hmm-mmm-mmm...

—Those who wish for victory. The total sum of that fervor
is what has brought about countless miracles
in the Twinkle Series in the past.

To head into the decisive battle...
We need just one more push.
A tailwind carrying all our feelings for Wonder Acute.
